tickerText: [TENNIS] Wimbledon 2026 wrapped Sunday with Jannik Sinner defending his title 6-7(7), 7-6(2), 6-3, 6-4 over Alexander Zverev and Linda Noskova claiming her first Grand Slam with a 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 win over Karolina Muchova — the fortnight's 10th straight different women's champion and Sinner's fifth major overall • [SQUASH] Sanya Vats is the lone Indian in the Chennai PSA Challenger semifinals after beating Unnati Tripathi, set to face top seed Rouqaia Othman — Suraj Chand's run ended in the men's quarters as Adham Roshdy rallied past the second seed • [BADMINTON] Japan Open Super 750 Day 1 in Tokyo: Malaysia's Leong Jun Hao upset world No. 19 Chi Yu-jen 21-19, 21-16 to reach the Round of 16, while top seeds Shi Yuqi and An Se-young open their campaigns at Tokyo Metropolitan Gymnasium • [PICKLEBALL] PPA Australia 250 Melbourne kicks off July 15 at Raya Pickleball Club, with the Macon PPA Challenger following July 17–19 and the sold-out inaugural Leapmotor PPA Asia 500 Open in Singapore July 23–26 drawing 150-plus pros from 13 countries • [TABLE TENNIS] Mongolia's first ITTF world-ranking events begin today in Ulaanbaatar with the WTT Youth Contender through July 17 and WTT Feeder July 19–23 hosting 300-plus athletes from 30 nations — the ITTF also cleared Russian players to return under their flag from July 28

newsItems.title: Sanya Vats Reaches Chennai PSA Challenger Semifinals
newsItems.excerpt: Fourth seed Sanya Vats is the lone Indian in the semifinals at the HCL Squash PSA Challenger Tour in Chennai after beating compatriot Unnati Tripathi 11-6, 11-5, 8-11, 11-8 on Monday. She faces Egyptian top seed Rouqaia Othman for a place in the final at the Indian Squash Academy.

newsItems.title: Jun Hao Upsets Chi Yu-jen on Japan Open Opening Day
newsItems.excerpt: Malaysia's Leong Jun Hao upset world No. 19 Chi Yu-jen 21-19, 21-16 in 50 minutes on the opening day of the DAIHATSU Japan Open Super 750 in Tokyo. The world No. 30 became the first Malaysian through to the men's singles Round of 16 at the $950,000 event at Tokyo Metropolitan Gymnasium.

newsItems.title: PPA Australia 250 Melbourne Opens Busy July Stretch
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Australia 250 Melbourne runs July 15–19 at Raya Pickleball Club, opening a packed month that includes the Macon PPA Challenger July 17–19 and the inaugural Leapmotor PPA Asia 500 Open in Singapore July 23–26. The Singapore event has sold out weekend sessions with 150-plus pros from 13 countries entered.

newsItems.title: Mongolia Hosts First ITTF World-Ranking Table Tennis Events
newsItems.excerpt: The WTT Youth Contender Ulaanbaatar 2026 begins today at the Buyant-Ukhaa Sports Complex, marking Mongolia's first ITTF world-ranking tournaments with 300-plus athletes from 30 countries. A WTT Feeder follows July 19–23, while the ITTF confirmed Russian players may compete under their flag from July 28.
